verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs have a dedicated page for this capability: create point-in-time sandbox snapshots, roll back to a checkpoint, and fork new sandboxes from them [blaxel-docs-21]. Archive/unarchive and snapshot-storage expiration policies further support snapshot persistence [blaxel-docs-22, blaxel-docs-25]. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of snapshot/fork behavior, and detail on snapshot fidelity (e.g., memory vs filesystem-only state).
